name: enum-group-only-by-a-decoding-method
description: A method of an enumerated type retains no member by being declared. Deleting the sentinel one past the last kind moves no constant, so it is test-only use where only tests name it, and its directive stays in effect. A kind only a test's stepping loop reaches is test-only use, kept by evidence in test files. The last member of a type whose text methods name the others moves nothing and is reported.
